🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Toukie Smith, the model and actress known for her role as Eva on the NBC sitcom 227 and for appearances on Miami Vice, has died at 74.

Smith died on November 4, 2026, at a New York hospital following a long, courageous battle with multiple sclerosis, according to an announcement from her twin children, Airyn and Julian, shared with The Hollywood Reporter. Her death was also reported by People.

Born Doris Smith on September 25, 1952, in Philadelphia, she took the stage name Toukie from a nickname her grandmother gave her. She attended the Fashion Institute of Technology and by 1972 was modeling for magazines including Vogue and Ebony, and for designers including Hubert de Givenchy, Thierry Mugler and Issey Miyake, as well as her brother, designer Willi Smith. She was named Bloomingdale's model of the year in 1978.

Her acting career took off in the late 1980s. She appeared in multiple episodes of season 4 of NBC's Miami Vice as Angie, and in 1989 she joined the cast of 227 as Eva, alongside Marla Gibbs. Her film roles included Talkin' Dirty After Dark, I Like It Like That and The Preacher's Wife. She also opened a restaurant under her own name on West Houston Street in New York City.

Smith is survived by her twin children, Airyn and Julian, whom she welcomed with former partner Robert De Niro in 1995.

Sources: People; The Hollywood Reporter.
